raw_segments.text: Aego, I do not like the office, but sith I am entered in this cause so far, pricked
to tea by foolish honesty and love I will go on. I lay with Cassio lately, and being
troubled with a raging tooth I could not sleep. There are a kind of men so loose of soul that
in their sleeps will mutter their affairs. One of this kind is Cassio. In sleep I heard
him say, Sweet Distimona, let us be wary, let us hide our loves. And then, sir, would
he gripe and wring my hand? cry, O sweet creature.
And then kiss me hard, as if he plucked up kisses by the roots that grew upon my lips,
